CHANGES_REQUIRED — independent exact-head review

Reviewed head: `a3f2b2b76dd6ce4c277a948babc4cc05e9344f64`
Reviewed tree: `ac85af90f4ac596748be295afec62a9a12b4b49e`

[P2] `--validate-only` still accepts transported byte drift in the third required output artifact. `validate_release` parses `kg-v0-release-manifest.json` and compares the resulting object with `expected_manifest`, but never compares the manifest file's raw bytes with the canonical authority-derived manifest bytes. On this exact head:

```text
original manifest sha256: baba4892a3079cc1a0d4fd6f698c9bbd9cfe59dce1a3b881cd08f3e1843d22c0
append " \\n"
drifted manifest sha256: 82a12fb8b62677c0d1d456cc39354e57940d66a0edfc6fc7c9871c58260538ba
python3 scripts/vlm/issue_1714_kg_v0_structural_materialization.py --validate-only --output-dir <drifted-release>
=> validated <drifted-release> (exit 0)
```

This leaves the release validator unable to authenticate byte identity for all three required outputs, despite the transported-byte-drift and two-clean-byte-identical-build boundaries. Compare the on-disk manifest bytes with `canonical_bytes(expected_manifest)` (or equivalent) and add a regression that drifts `kg-v0-release-manifest.json` itself.

Other exact-head verification completed successfully: 14/14 focused tests, 32/32 predecessor tests, `--check`, `--validate-only` on the unmodified release, py_compile, independent full identity/parentage/anchor/edge conservation, all hard counters, and two clean byte-identical builds. All four existing review threads were resolved at review time. This BLOCK does not authorize Stage 2 or claim final correctness.


The previously reproduced manifest-byte-drift probe now rejects with `KgV0Error: release manifest byte identity mismatch`. The PR body is current for this SHA/tree, the diff remains bounded to five files and three active outputs, and unresolved review threads were `0` at verdict time.

This PASS is SHA-bound and invalid on any head drift. It is Stage 1 review evidence only: it is not merge authority, does not bypass pending CI, and does not authorize Stage 2 before merge plus exact-main readback.
